allow_path.evidence: the evaluator ALLOWs only on a NODE_HEALTH_REPORTED receipt on the ledger chain (llm_adapter/healthy_node_evaluator.py:70 HEALTH_REPORT_CLASS @0b37fe3b786a2de687235f5d9d146af49ffee9cd), and no transition at #428 produces one (run hn-producer-search); the producer exists only in StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#429 draft @5f5f7bbeea96d5f313effaa02f86b01196465247 (run hn-producer-search-429), so ALLOW needs code that is not yet admitted

degraded_forms.E0: no LLM: LLM-adapter#428 admit() returns a six-field disposition and sets healthy_node_established only on the pinned evaluator's ALLOW; the evaluator reads the newest NODE_HEALTH_REPORTED receipt on the ledger chain (observed)
degraded_forms.E1: one LLM lane authors repairs to the healthy-node determination; the deterministic verifier and exact-head CI receipts stand in for cross-checking
degraded_forms.E2: two LLM lanes: one authors a repair to the healthy-node determination, one cross-checks it; the deterministic verifier decides
degraded_forms.E3: three LLM lanes may author repairs to the healthy-node determination and cross-check each other's diffs; the deterministic verifier alone decides the verdict

failure_class.reason: a missing capability Lane B builds: the NODE_HEALTH_REPORTED producer (LLM-adapter#429 draft)

items.observed_state: every refusal row six-field (FAIL_CLOSED NODE_NOT_CURRENTLY_ADMITTED_HEALTHY; standing DENY), none raised; suites 74 ran, 0 skipped; the unhealthy-report case on a populated ledger is DENY HEALTH_REPORTED_NOT_HEALTHY (run layer1-two-layer-probe LAYER1_UNHEALTHY_REPORT); no NODE_HEALTH_REPORTED producer at #428 (run hn-producer-search: only the class constant), one only in draft #429 (llm_adapter/node_health_report_producer.py produce())
items.subject: REQUESTER_IS_CURRENTLY_ADMITTED_HEALTHY_NODE
items.what: the determination that the requester is a currently admitted healthy node, which layer 1 consumes; it must itself have an E0 path that refuses an unhealthy, unknown or not-via-InTr requester with six fields

allow_path.by: evaluate_anchored(node_id, endpoint=, org_ledger_root=, org_ledger_head_receipt_sha256=, ...) takes the ledgers and the head as inputs; the anchor pair and NODE_LEDGER_OPENED are receipts

bypass_paths: evaluate_anchored's transport_state is a caller argument defaulting to INSTALLED (llm_adapter/endpoint_ledger_anchor.py:650-651 @c2c57505535fb89ee88477eda1378c5fc610e0f7), not read from an installed InTr transport's receipts: an anchored root with no transport input is ALLOW (run anchor432-probe ANCHORED_ROOT_DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_STATE), and NOT_YET_ENABLED refuses only when the caller passes it (ANCHORED_ROOT_TRANSPORT_NOT_YET_ENABLED)

evaluate_anchored takes node_id as a caller argument (:650); the wrapper does not derive the identity it evaluates from a verified proof of the requester's node_identity_key - the key is read from the endpoint's own genesis and the NODE_LEDGER_OPENED record, both written by whoever opens the ledger

org_ledger_root and org_ledger_head_receipt_sha256 are caller arguments: _org_chain (:464) checks only that the supplied copy's HEAD.json equals the supplied head, and NODE_LEDGER_OPENED is sealed by its own sha256 with nothing signed (opened_record_failure checks record_sha256 = sha of the record; StegOS#427 @f77cf07505615b7ad3db11338cb252a2638040e2 stegos/ephemeral_node_ledger_open.py states 'nothing is signed', read via the GitHub contents API, not an observe root), so a caller-created org-ledger directory holding a resealed record anchors any root (run anchor432-probe SELF_MINTED_ANCHOR_ON_CALLER_CREATED_ORG_LEDGER: ALLOW); the anchor carries authority only when the org ledger is the contract-location ledger at a pinned genesis, which KV's consuming side must pass (LC-KV-15)

degraded_forms.E0: no LLM: evaluate_anchored runs verify_anchor and then the unchanged healthy-node evaluator, refusing an unanchored root, a root with no genesis and an org head that is not the supplied copy's with six-field FAIL_CLOSED TEMP_NODE_LEDGER_NOT_ANCHORED (observed)
degraded_forms.E1: one LLM lane authors repairs to the endpoint ledger anchor; the deterministic verifier and exact-head CI receipts stand in for cross-checking
degraded_forms.E2: two LLM lanes: one authors a repair to the endpoint ledger anchor, one cross-checks it; the deterministic verifier decides
degraded_forms.E3: three LLM lanes may author repairs to the endpoint ledger anchor and cross-check each other's diffs; the deterministic verifier alone decides the verdict

failure_class.reason: a missing capability Lane B builds (Coordination's routing via Lane B): transport only from an installed InTr transport read from receipts, identity only from a verified node_identity_key proof, in the evaluate_anchored wrapper

Still ALLOW: an anchored root with no transport input, and a root anchored by a caller-resealed NODE_LEDGER_OPENED on a caller-created org-ledger directory
items.subject: ENDPOINT_LEDGER_ANCHOR_SUITE
items.what: the endpoint ledger anchor layer 1 will consume (Lane D reports its next cvk#258 push switches layer 1 to it): a temporary node ledger root is admissible only when anchored by a NODE_LEDGER_OPENED receipt on the org ledger or TVC-issued, binding node_id, node_identity_key and the temporary genesis hash (Coordination ruling as relayed by Lane B; a claim); StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#432 evaluate_anchored, with NODE_LEDGER_OPENED emitted at EPHEMERAL generation by StegVerse-Labs/StegOS#427
